name: Zapier
summary: No-code automation platform that connects apps so a trigger in one starts actions in others, with a free plan and paid tiers by task volume.
best_for: Small teams and founders who want to connect the apps they already use so data moves on its own, and are happy to pay per task as volume grows
skip_if: you only need a single two-step handoff, you want fixed costs that do not grow with usage, you need to self-host your data, or you want a tool we have tested ourselves
honest_knock: Pricing is based on tasks, so a busy month can cost more than the starting price suggests. Free allows only two-step Zaps. Since 15 June 2026 AI steps are priced by model tier and can use more tasks per run. We have not used Zapier ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Professional · Free $0 with 100 tasks a month and two-step Zaps
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-16 on zapier.com/pricing, US dollars a month) Zapier connects apps with automations called Zaps. Free costs $0 and includes unlimited Zaps, Tables and Forms, two-step Zaps and 100 tasks a month. Professional starts from $19.99 a month and Team from $69 a month, with 1 seat on Professional and 25 on Team. The page has a Pay yearly toggle that saves 33%, and its text does not say which billing period the starting prices assume. A new account gets a 14-day trial of Professional with no card. You can cancel at any time and keep the plan until the billing cycle ends. A task is any successful action. We have not paid for a plan.
